# 4) Write your first article

posts/01-manifolds.qmd

---
title: "What is a manifold?"
---

A manifold is, informally, a space that locally looks like $\mathbb{R}^n$.

## Motivation

We want to generalize curves and surfaces.

## Definition

A topological manifold is a space such that...

$$
\phi: U \to \mathbb{R}^n
$$

is a homeomorphism.
